build_image_dataset_from_folder: build a dataset from an image folder using ImageFolder with data_dir pointing to image files
create_imagefolder_config_with_drop_labe: create an ImageFolderConfig with drop_labels set to true to skip label inference from folder structure
load_imagefolder_dataset_with_metadata: load an ImageFolder dataset that reads metadata.csv alongside images in the data directory
review_imagefolder_extensions_list: review the IMAGE_EXTENSIONS list to verify which image file formats are supported by ImageFolder
refactor_imagefolder_to_add_extension: refactor the IMAGE_EXTENSIONS list to add a new supported image file extension like .heic
